content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Edward Fleming (E042)
Request: write access to Source Code
Role: Payroll Specialist
Employment type: contractor
Security training: basic (not advanced)

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Edward is a contractor without advanced security training, so his maximum access is read. He requested write, which is above read. Per policy, if requested level is above maximum, grant the maximum = read.

So decision: read.
